votes.motion: MOVED TO AMEND THE AGENDA BY MOVING THE ITEM PERTAINING TO ADOPTION OF A CITY FLAG TO FOLLOW THE ANNUAL REPORT FROM THE OGDEN CITY YOUTH COUNCIL. VICE CHAIR RICHEY SECONDED THE MOTION,

ON A MOTION BY COUNCIL MEMBER HYER AND SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER WHITE, ORDINANCE WAS PASSED AND ADOPTED AS OGDEN CITY ORDINANCE 2023-24 AND ORDERED POSTED AS REQUIRED BY LAW [ENTITLED: "An ordinance of Ogden City, Utah, amending the Ogden Municipal Code by amending Section 1-5-4 to amend provisions pertaining to a City Flag; and by providing that this ordinance shall become effective immediately upon posting after final passage."]
votes.subject: An ordinance of Ogden City, Utah, amending the Ogden Municipal Code by amending Section 1-5-4 to amend provisions pertaining to a City Flag; and by providing that this ordinance shall become effective immediately upon posting after final passage.

votes.motion: MOVED TO APPROVE THE MINUTES AS PRESENTED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER BLAIR,
MOVED THE PUBLIC HEARING BE CLOSED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY VICE CHAIR RICHEY,

ON A MOTION BY COUNCIL MEMBER BLAIR AND SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER NADOLSKI, ORDINANCE WAS PASSED AND ADOPTED AS OGDEN CITY ORDINANCE 2023-23 AND ORDERED POSTED AS REQUIRED BY LAW [ENTITLED: "An ordinance of Ogden City amending the budget for the Fiscal Year July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023 by increasing the anticipated revenues for a gross increase of $4,033,825 from sources as detailed in the body of this ordinance; and increasing the appropriations for a gross increase of $4,033,825 as detailed in the body of this ordinance; and providing that this ordinance shall become effective immediately upon posting after final passage."]
